map.IMEI 号码验证器。输入 14 或 15 位手机串号，按 Luhn 算法校验校: IMEI number validator. Enter a 14- or 15-digit phone serial, validate the check digit by the Luhn algorithm, for device identity verification, lost-and-found, and pre-second-hand-trade number legality checks.
map.Luhn：由右至左偶位 × 2（> 9 减 9）后求和，总和 mod 10 =: Luhn: from right to left, even positions × 2 (subtract 9 if >9) then sum, total mod 10 = 0; IMEI 14 digits, IMEISV 15 digits
map.依据 Luhn 算法校验 IMEI/IMEISV 的校验位，前 8 位 TAC: Per the Luhn algorithm, validate the check digit of IMEI/IMEISV; the first 8 digits TAC can identify the device model; for device identity verification, lost-and-found and second-hand trade checks.
map.校验 15 位 IMEI 的 Luhn 校验位（14 位时按规则补校验位）: Validate the 15-digit IMEI Luhn check digit (pad to a check digit when 14 digits)
map.二手交易、保修登记前核对手机串号: Verify the phone serial before second-hand trades and warranty registration
map.解析 TAC 型号分配码与序列号分段: Parse the TAC model-allocation code and serial-number segments
map.示例：IMEI 校验位与分段: Example: IMEI check digit and segmentation
map.输入 490154203237518，页面按 Luhn 校验第 15 位，并解析: Enter 490154203237518; the page checks the 15th digit by Luhn and parses the TAC (49015420) and serial segment; changing the last digit fails.
map.IMEI 15 位与 14 位的关系？: What is the relationship between 15- and 14-digit IMEI?
map.14 位为设备主体（TAC 8 位+序列号 6 位），第 15 位是按 Luhn: 14 digits is the device body (TAC 8 digits + serial 6 digits); the 15th is the Luhn check digit; some implementations use the last two digits as a software version number.
map.校验通过代表手机正品吗？: Does passing validation mean the phone is genuine?
map.不代表。IMEI 校验只验证格式，是否报失、是否为正品须在运营商或厂商数据库查询: No. The IMEI check only verifies format; whether it is reported lost or genuine must be queried in the operator's or manufacturer's database.
map.IMEI 和 MEID 的区别？: What is the difference between IMEI and MEID?
map.IMEI 用于 GSM/UMTS/LTE 设备，MEID 用于 CDMA 设备，: IMEI is for GSM/UMTS/LTE devices, MEID for CDMA devices; the two differ in format and length.
